rooms.note: Private room inside the original bank vault, with screen and sound.

rooms.name: Main dining room
rooms.note: A section of the banking hall or the full room. No buyout required.

faq.q: Do my guests choose their own entrée?
faq.a: Yes. Each guest chooses their own main course from the options on your menu.

faq.q: How does a hosted event work?
faq.a: It is prix-fixe and fully served. You choose a per-guest menu, we assign a coordinator, and setup, service and timing are handled for you. Send the estimate form or call, and we reply with availability and a written proposal.
Yes. Every menu has a vegetarian main course, and gluten-free and other needs are handled on request. Note them in the estimate form or tell your coordinator.

faq.q: How many guests can you host?
faq.a: The Vault, our restored 1920s bank-vault room, seats 12 to 22. Parties of 23 to 100 take the main dining room, with no buyout required. The whole restaurant can also be closed to the public for the evening.

faq.q: What is the difference between an event menu and catering?
faq.a: Event menus are served at the restaurant, in The Vault or the dining room. Catering is family-style trays delivered to your office or venue, ordered from the Catering trays view of this page or through ezCater.
